title: The data of the gate before cycle.started
description: The ask of the gate before cycle.started: a start is decided and its container has not started. Its JSON ships in 2.0; the gate is raised from 2.1. Version 1 of the events. host/docs/api.md, "Events", says what each field means. The object is closed; a minor release may add an optional field. console/tests/events_contract.rs checks the samples beside this file against it.

blueprint.description: The blueprint, the factory API's issue.

ticket.description: The ticket, in the ports' shape. Left out when it is the blueprint.

how.description: What started the cycle, as status and history print it: approved, refresh, outage-retry, millwright, host, reply, answer or hand. May grow.

by.description: The login that started it, as status prints running[].by. Left out for a cycle run by hand.

approval.description: The approval's time. The key's second part and at.
